description: Record a heads-up postflop solve request. Required: title, board, pot (bb), effective_stack (bb). The job stays pending: solver dispatch and billing are not configured, so this does not start a solve.

add_allin.description: Add an all-in branch alongside the bet sizes.

bet_sizes.description: Bet sizes as fractions of the pot, e.g. [0.33, 0.75].

effective_stack.description: Effective stack behind, in big blinds.

ip_range.description: In-position range in the same weights format.

oop_range.description: Out-of-position range as hand-class weights, e.g. "AA:1,AKs:0.42". Defaults are left to the solver config.

tags.description: Free-form tags stored with the job.

title.description: Label for the job, 1 to 120 characters.

name: enqueue_solve

outputSchema.description: One recorded solve request. Dispatch is not configured, so a job stays pending and never gets a solution id.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp the job was recorded.

reason.description: Why the job does not start a solve.

solution_id.description: Always null while dispatch is disabled.

title.description: Title given when the job was recorded.

title: Record a solve request
